title: tools.md says the kbask observer session loads no MCP server, but it loads the kb's own with three read-only tools
goal: kb/_self/tools.md's kbask.py row says what session_argv passes: --mcp-config with --strict-mcp-config for the kb MCP server alone, and kb_backlog, kb_querylog and kb_monitor_status among the --allowedTools, as monitoring.md says

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbask;argv=kbask.session_argv('claude');t=open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8').read();assert '--mcp-config' not in argv or 'and no MCP server' not in t,'kb/_self/tools.md says the kbask session loads no MCP server, but session_argv passes --mcp-config'

clauses.clause: kb/_self/tools.md's kbask.py row says what session_argv passes: --mcp-config with --strict-mcp-config for the kb MCP server alone
kb_backlog, kb_querylog and kb_monitor_status among the --allowedTools, as monitoring.md says
